face-api.js 0.22.2, Tiny Face Detector, and tiny 68-point landmark model
https://github.com/justadudewhohacks/face-api.js

All JavaScript and model weights are served from this Site. No third-party runtime requests are required.

https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/tree/master/body-pix
